# Vendored KaTeX

KaTeX 0.16.22 (MIT, see LICENSE), from the npm package `katex@0.16.22`
(tarball SHA-256 `e9e0d167db3175481cbadaff38e8d90b130f6a3ddb451a47e43c577fd511f365`):
`dist/katex.min.js`, `dist/katex.min.css` and the `.woff2` fonts from
`dist/fonts/`, unchanged. The `.woff` and `.ttf` fonts are left out; every
browser SF Agents supports loads `.woff2`.

GenUI views (`web/public/genui.js`) load it when a view shows math.
